text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yo! It's your birthday, right? Congrats, 
Tap!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hm? Hey, Tap! Did you hear me? Congratula—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: I heard you loud and clear. ...Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. But I only just found out a second 
ago! So I haven't gotten a present ready 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I figured I might as well just ask you 
directly! Is there anything you want?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
... ...Then hey, run alongside me next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see that insane running of yours 
up close.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You're good with that? Of course, let's 
run together! To wherever you want, until 
your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. There is no better 
gift than this!
